$comment: When a page opened through Remote Access (/tunnel/<id>/panel/ or /tunnel/<id>/programmer/) has lost its session. Read by the panel's (web/panel/modules/access.js) and the Programmer's (web/programmer/src/api/auth.ts) isEndedRemoteSession and isEndedRemoteClose, through the panel harness's remote_session scenarios and remoteSessionEnded.test.ts. Each cloud answer is written word for word as the cloud's tunnel sends it. 'answers' are replies to a request made inside the session: the system answers every error as JSON, and the cloud refuses a request for a session that is gone with bare text (a 404 once it was closed or timed out, a 401 for an access token missing or expired, a 403 starting 'Remote access ended' when its access ended mid-session). 'closes' are how the page's own socket closed: the cloud closes an ended session's sockets with the wire contract's session_ended code (ws_close_codes). Every case is asked inside a Remote Access session; on the system's own address nothing here ends anything. A case added here runs in both pages' suites.

answers.name: the cloud's 404 for a session that was closed or timed out
answers.body: Remote access ended. Open a new session from the portal.

answers.name: the cloud's 401 for an access token missing or expired
answers.body: Remote access ended. Open a new session from the portal.

answers.name: the cloud's 403 for a session whose access ended mid-session
answers.body: Remote access ended. Open a new session from the portal.

answers.name: an older cloud's 404 for a session that is gone
answers.body: Tunnel not found or not active

answers.name: an older cloud's 401 for an access token that expired
answers.body: Unauthorized — invalid or missing tunnel access token

answers.name: a bare-text refusal marked as plain text
answers.body: Remote access ended. Open a new session from the portal.

answers.name: the system's own 401, which asks for its password
the system's own 404, only a missing thing
the system's own 401 as JSON with a charset, whatever it says
answers.body: Remote access ended. Open a new session from the portal.

answers.name: the system's own 403 as JSON with a charset, whatever it says
answers.body: Remote access ended. Open a new session from the portal.

answers.name: the system's own 404 as JSON with a charset, whatever it says
answers.body: Remote access ended. Open a new session from the portal.

answers.name: the cloud's 403 for a change a panel session may not make
answers.body: This remote session is for the touch panel and cannot change the system's configuration.

answers.name: the cloud's 403 for a Programmer page a panel session may not open
answers.body: This remote session is for the touch panel. Programming access is not enabled for your organization.

answers.name: the cloud's 403 for remote video the plan does not include
answers.body: Remote video is not included in this plan. This stream still plays on panels in the space.

answers.name: the cloud's 403 for a request another page made
the cloud's 502 while the system is not connected
the cloud's 503 while its tunnel service is unavailable
the cloud's 504 for a request the system did not answer in time

closes.name: the cloud's code with no reason: the code says it
a plain close, which the page asks about
the system could not open the socket on its own server
the system's credential refusal
closes.reason: Authentication is no longer valid. Reconnect to authenticate again.

closes.name: the system's interface switched off
closes.reason: This interface is disabled by the product settings.

closes.name: the system's Preview sign-in refusal
closes.reason: Authentication is no longer valid. Reconnect to authenticate again.

closes.name: the system is not ready yet
